content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides a correlation between A1C levels and estimated average glucose (eAG) values, as outlined in Table 6.1. This table offers equivalent eAG levels corresponding to various A1C percentages. Research has demonstrated a robust correlation between A1C values and glucose levels obtained through blood glucose monitoring or continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). This evidence supports the clinical utility of A1C as a reliable marker for assessing long-term glycemic control in patients.
